mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chain activity and economic output, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600 thousand signal severe housing market contraction, depressing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 600.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent federal funds rate increases and unemployment above 9.5% signal monetary tightening amid weak labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2% in 3 months and UNRATE > 9.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.2% and UNRATE >9.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220 indicates high inflation regime, triggering aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.
